title: Tokenized Asset Map issuer key file, version 1
description: Served by an issuer at https://<its domain>/.well-known/iomarkets-asset-map.json. Each key is an ed25519 public key; an attestation whose key is one of these, and whose signature verifies over the entry's canonical form, is the issuer's own signature on the entry.
